question: Which statement about the dissolving of sugar ($\mathrm{C_{12}H_{22}O_{11}}$) in water is most accurate at the AP Chemistry level?

distractor_notes.B: No new compound forms during evaporation.
distractor_notes.C: Mass of the substance is conserved (it becomes gas).
